answer.answer: Amine-functionalised (PS-NH2) polystyrene nanoparticles are consistently reported with positive zeta potentials (commonly +20 to +40 mV) in the literature, with none reported as negative. Yes, these particles are positively charged, though the exact magnitude varies with pH and medium ionic strength.
